name: t3-lab-grok
description: Delegate from a parent chat (Cursor Agent, Grok Bot, Codex) to official T3 Nightly environments with durable operations, verified checkouts and text-first status.

T3_LAB_OWNER.title: T3 lab owner
T3_LAB_OWNER.description: Optional UUID journal partition for this install. Generate your own (python3 -c "import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())") and set it in Plugins → Configure, or leave it empty to use the private owner file written by `uv run --frozen python setup.py init`. mcp.json only references ${T3_LAB_OWNER}; never commit a real owner UUID.

interface.longDescription: Keep your parent chat (Cursor Agent, Grok Bot, or Codex) as the main conversation. Launch work through the official T3 client APIs, recover the same operation after a cut, and open its exact T3 thread to intervene. No automatic idle-chat wake. Codex may supply _meta.threadId; other hosts use T3_LAB_OWNER. Prepared for community use; not yet listed on the Cursor Marketplace.
interface.defaultPrompt: Ask Claude and Grok for a second opinion on a file, in parallel.
